dialogues.speaker: Ermolov
dialogues.text: "What happened?" Please... as if nothing's going on. That's what those officials would like to believe.

dialogues.speaker: Ermolov
dialogues.text: The so-called officials — if they see us living like this, all they'll say is, "Citizens, let us unite and overcome these difficult times together."

dialogues.speaker: Ermolov
dialogues.text: Hmph. Easy for them to say. Ever since Project Stuzha began, everyone's been tightening their belts. My restaurant's business has been getting worse and worse...

dialogues.speaker: Ermolov
dialogues.text: Now we can't even get crystal ore anymore. Forget running a business, at this rate, we won't even have fire to cook at home.

dialogues.speaker: Ermolov
dialogues.text: But I bet those Fatui, that liaison officer, and the mayor — they're all sitting pretty with more than enough crystal ore.

dialogues.speaker: Ermolov
dialogues.text: Honestly, if those useless people weren't around... Hmph, maybe the whole town could hold on a bit longer.
